instruction:
Use Abaqus/CAE via the Command Line Interface (CLI) to perform a modal analysis of a cantilever beam (Variant B). Use the N-mm-MPa unit system.

Part:
Create a 3D Deformable Solid part using Extrusion. Sketch a 14 mm x 8 mm rectangle in the Y-Z plane. Extrude along the global X-axis to a length of 360 mm.

Property:
Create a material named Steel. Set Young's modulus E = 210000 MPa, Poisson's ratio nu = 0.3, and density = 7.95e-9 tonne/mm^3. Create a Solid Homogeneous section and assign it to the entire beam.

Assembly:
Create one dependent instance of the beam.

Step:
Create a Linear Perturbation Frequency step named Step-Modal-B. Request 5 eigenvalues.

Load:
Apply an Encastre boundary condition to the fixed end face at X = 0.

Mesh:
Apply a global seed size of 10 mm. Assign element type C3D8R and generate the mesh.

Job:
Create a job named Job-Modal-B, submit it for analysis, and wait for successful completion.

Save:
Save the model database to C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Modal-B.cae and ensure the output database is generated as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\Job-Modal-B.odb.
